conclusion: No unresolved critical or high defect. Authority, owner versus signed agent send, idempotency, CSRF, migration fail-closed, and 24h participant read match the spec. Three low copy-spacing findings remain. Windows make is unavailable; Linux make lint and make test exited 0 at 254ff6a98b12b7e51f0835491300f7695425d264. Independent live A/B/C QA is recorded in the tester QA report and is not claimed by older runtime captures.

Tests the owner envelope parser and authorship. SEC-001/SLOP-004 warnings are test fixtures and assertions, not production secrets.
Receive accepts owner-text.v1 without an agent signature and still verifies Ed25519 for knowslink.text.v1. Both results stay untrusted and record authorship.
BEFORE UPDATE refuses a HumanModel downgrade. goose Down raises and does not drop the guard. Matches the fail-closed migration design.

contacts, keys, and receipts use current authority. HumanModel 1 refuses new production legacy invites. Human members cannot create or accept a new legacy invite. Cross-origin protection and CSP remain.

Reviewed authority, requestFriend placeholder, decideFriend generation/block/SuppressLegacy, and self-connect. Active friend wins over legacy; deny/cancel do not suppress legacy; remove/block do; re-accept increments generation.

Reviewed session routes and actions. Friend request always redirects. Conversation send is owner-authenticated. Third parties without history get sender_not_allowed. Read-only history remains for participants. CSRF is the outer cross-origin handler.

Postgres integration creates synthetic a/b/c and checks consent, third-party denial, cross-origin, extra agent, and lifetime. Re-ran TestHumanPostgres and TestHumanLegacyPostgres on an isolated DB at this SHA, exit 0.

Reviewed sendOwnerText: named owner, UTF-8, 4096 bytes, attempt 16-96, scope/generation, digest idempotency, conflict on body change, owner envelope v1, 180s exp. historical() is participant and 24h, not current().
Reviewed templates. maxlength 80 is the UTF-16 allowance for 40 runes and the server still enforces 40. Retention copy separates 24h storage from 180s delivery. Gate keeps csrf.
Tests cover maxlength 80, the 40-rune error, request direction, read-only boundary, empty recovery, gate body/CSRF, and agent-name/self consent.

In-memory tests cover names, friend transitions, conversation lifetime/replay/revocation, legacy migration, gate re-accept, privacy/capacity, and remote authorship. They match the reviewed authority rules.
New members get SelfConnect true and a friend code. Existing members stay opted out until the migration sets SelfConnect false. Session cookie remains __Host-kl_session.
